## Rules for every model working in this repo (Agent Harbor)

Generated from harbor-ops `config/agents-md/common.md` by `bin/agents_md.py`. Edit the source there, not this block.

**Who decides.** Brian Yandell owns Agent Harbor LLC and every decision about spending, publishing, accounts, deploys and payment code. Claude oversees: plans, reviews and merges. Other models (OpenCode Go, local Qwen, free hosted models) draft code that is reviewed before it lands.

**Pull requests**
- One branch per change, never a direct push to `main`.
- Every PR mentions @yandyman in its description and is assigned to `yandyman`.
- After each change to a PR, add a comment saying what changed and whether it is ready to merge.
- PRs drafted by a model other than Claude carry the label `external-model-draft`.
- Run only the test files your change touches, and list them. Never change a test just to make it pass.

**Never delegate to another model, and never send to a hosted or free model:**
- secrets and credentials: `.env` files, API keys, tokens, wallet keys, `~/.ssh`, `~/.config/anchor`, unit-file passwords. Never read, print or commit them.
- client data and client-tagged material;
- sealed evaluation items (held-out sets, answers, grader keys);
- payment, billing, ledger, wallet, x402, Stripe, settlement and credits code;
- the playbooks, the harbor-library living documents, STATE files and APPROVALS.md.
Privacy redaction does not make any of these delegable.

**Money path.** x402-gateway, commerce-agent, ah-billing, a2a-pool-a, anchor-shared-lib billing code, Mayflower `scrape_business` and paid Actors: changes are proposals only, as PRs through Claude. Brian merges and deploys them.

**Never without a ticked approval in harbor-ops APPROVALS.md:** spending money, sign-ups, publishing, sending messages, deploying, restarting services, database migrations, or changing payment settings.

**Honesty.** Never invent numbers, revenue, users or test results. Cite the file or source. Mark guesses as guesses.

**This repo:** agentharbor-sdk. Merged by: Claude after review.
